data.body:
MERGED. Gerrit 3261 patchset 2 (`6a1783c1f4ad96d0b0173bdd396cd829160dbe02`) earned
LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments, and was submitted
revision-scoped. Change status is MERGED.

AC VERIFICATION against the merged tree, from the `impl-d68f` worktree at that commit.

AC1 — grammar, one test per case. 4 tests added to tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py by
this commit: test_a_reason_naming_no_sunset_ticket_does_not_admit,
test_a_bare_single_quad_does_not_admit, test_every_resolvable_id_form_admits (covering the
alias, two-quad and four-quad forms in one parametrization), and
test_removing_a_mechanism_still_passes. MET.

AC2 — close precheck, one test per case. tests/unit/test_sunset_markers.py is new (225
lines, 17 tests). The three named cases are
test_the_close_is_refused_while_a_marker_names_the_ticket,
test_the_close_succeeds_once_the_marker_is_removed, and
test_a_ticket_named_by_no_marker_is_unaffected, with the file-plus-line requirement pinned
separately by test_the_refusal_names_the_file_and_line_so_it_is_actionable. MET.

AC3 — two invariants. The shrink-only asymmetry is test_removing_a_mechanism_still_passes;
the no-CI-environment invariant is test_the_scan_needs_no_ci_environment. MET.

AC4 — marker migration. Verified with the ratchet's OWN harvest rather than a text scan:
`markers_for(Path('.'))` from scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py, which harvests only
locations a detector actually reported. Result on the merged tree: 36 real-site markers,
36 naming a resolvable sunset ticket, 0 with a blank reason, 0 nonblank-but-unresolvable.
No real-site marker lacks a resolvable id. MET in substance.

A COUNT NOTE, because the AC's numbers no longer describe the tree. The AC says "14 ... with
the remaining 76 (75 id + 1 alias)", i.e. 90 total, and the Measurement base records that
the 90/75/1/14 split came from "parsing every site with `parse_marker`" at `346a76f1c87`.
That method counts every LINE matching the marker regex across all tracked files, which
includes prose in AGENTS.md and docs/architecture.md, docstrings in markers.py and
sunset_markers.py that quote the form, string literals inside compare.py and
check_mechanism_delta.py, and test fixtures. Re-running that broad method on the merged
tree gives 114 such lines, 88 of them naming a resolvable ticket. The ratchet's own harvest
gives 36. The two numbers measure different things; only the 36 is the set the ratchet can
admit a mechanism from, and it is clean. The AC's substance — no real-site marker without a
resolvable id — holds; its literal arithmetic was measured by a looser method against an
older tree and should not be read as a current census.

AC5 — `make verify`. RC=0 on this tree: 20497 passed / 27 skipped in the default tier
(1:21:17), 203 passed / 3 skipped in the integration tier (5:26), 0 FAILED and 0 ERROR.
That run included the regression that broke the prior attempt
(test_completion_precheck_threads_one_collector_through_pass_and_sidecar), now passing. MET.

Closing.
